description: This Java source file defines a class SendEmailTask that extends AbstractTask and represents a scheduled task responsible for sending emails within the OpenMRS platform. The class includes methods to execute the task, which involves opening and closing a session, and a shutdown method for cleanup.

classes.name: SendEmailTask
classes.description: A task class designed to send emails, extends AbstractTask, and manages session lifecycle during execution.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Starts a session, logs the execution of the email sending task, then closes the session.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Logs the shutdown process for the email task.
